CREATE TABLE memory_situation_source_bindings (
	manifest_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	entry_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	resolution_policy VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	original_entry_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	basis_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	basis_source_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	basis_source_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	resolved_source JSON NOT NULL, 
	resolved_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	resolution_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (manifest_id, entry_ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(manifest_id) REFERENCES memory_situation_manifests (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_situation_binding_ordinals CHECK (entry_ordinal >= 0 AND basis_ordinal >= 0)
)
